question: What was the HDI value of China in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__0.768__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The HDI is a composite index that measures the average achievements of a country in three basic dimensions of human development, namely, a long and healthy life, access to knowledge, and a decent standard of living.**
 
• HDI value of China in **2021** is **0.768**, which is considered to be a high human development score and China 's rank was **79th**.
 
• The HDI establishes "goalposts"—minimum and maximum values—for each dimension and then displays the position of each nation in respect to these values. A number between 0 and 1 is used to represent this.
 
• The higher a nation's HDI value, the higher its level of human development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The HDI is a composite summary indicator that evaluates a nation's average performance in three fundamental areas of human development: standard of living, knowledge, and health. **
 
• **The HDI is calculated by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and is used as a standard measure of human development across the world.**
 
• With the exception of 2012 and 2020–21, the HDI has been published yearly since its initial release in 1990.
 
• The Human Development Index (HDI) has four categories: low human development (below 0.55), medium human development (0.55-.70), high human development (0.7-0.79), and very high human development (0.8-1.0).
